title: Engenheiro(a) de Soluções de IA
description:
Você não será apenas um executor de código, mas um orquestrador de inteligência . Seu foco será utilizar as ferramentas mais avançadas de IA generativa (como Claude, Antigravity e IDEs baseadas em agentes) para construir sistemas autônomos, seguros e altamente eficientes. Buscamos alguém que domine o \"vibe coding\": a capacidade de iterar rápido, prototipar em linguagem natural e refinar com código sólido.


O que buscamos

  • Capacidade de alternar entre \"pensar o produto\" e \"debugar o código\" rapidamente.
  • Curiosidade para testar a ferramenta, mas maturidade para escolher a que resolve o problema.
  • Capacidade de transformar tarefas recorrentes em fluxos autônomos, desenhando agentes que resolvam a fricção operacional de forma sistêmica.


Responsabilidades Refinadas

  • Arquitetura de Conhecimento Dinâmico (RAG): Desenvolver e otimizar estratégias de recuperação de dados para que a IA tenha contexto preciso, garantindo que a resposta certa chegue no momento certo, independentemente da base de dados utilizada.
  • Orquestração de Ecossistemas Autônomos: Projetar e implementar agentes de IA que não apenas respondem, mas executam tarefas complexas, integrando diferentes modelos e ferramentas de fluxo de trabalho.
  • Engenharia de Performance e Prompting: Dominar a comunicação com LLMs para extrair o máximo de performance com o menor custo computacional, utilizando técnicas avançadas de encadeamento de pensamento (CoT) e versionamento de instruções.
  • Segurança e Ética Operacional: Blindar as soluções contra vulnerabilidades (como injeção de prompt) e garantir que o fluxo de dados respeite normas de privacidade (LGPD), criando uma camada de confiança entre o usuário e a máquina.
  • Ciclo de Melhoria Contínua (Evals): Implementar frameworks de avaliação (Evals) para medir a \"verdade\" e a utilidade das respostas da IA, garantindo que o sistema aprenda e melhore a cada iteração em produção.
  • Integração Híbrida (Code & No-Code): Atuar como a ponte entre o desenvolvimento customizado (Python/Node.js) e plataformas de automação (n8n/Make), garantindo que APIs e serviços de nuvem funcionem em perfeita harmonia.


O que oferecemos: Cartão iFood (VA/VR) | Auxílio Home Office | Convênio Médico Amil + Bradesco Odontológico | Wellhub | Desconto exclusivo em produtos Multilaser | Convênios Educacionais.



Sobre o Grupo Multilaser

O Grupo Multilaser foi fundado em 1987. Desde lá, seguimos crescendo, ampliando mercado e construindo parcerias duradouras junto aos nossos colaboradores, consumidores, clientes e investidores.


Temos 4 atributos importantes que nos definem: somos democráticos, humanos, antenados e descontraídos. Um dos nossos principais pilares é facilitar a vida das pessoas através da tecnologia. Em nossa Cultura, temos 3 pilares que nos orientam e direcionam: Gerar valor ao cliente, Fazer o certo do jeito certo e Sinceridade com Respeito.


Atuamos em mais de 15 categorias, temos 3 fábricas no Brasil e um laboratório na China, além dos escritórios em São Paulo e Belo Horizonte. São mais de 5 mil itens em portfólio, presentes em mais de 40 mil pontos de venda e em mais de 30 marketplaces parceiros.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: IT Risk Management Lead

• Drive treatment planning, cross‑functional coordination, and lifecycle tracking

• Deliver risk reporting, dashboards, and decision‑ready materials for leadership

• Support governance cycles, audit readiness, and GRC tooling adoption

title: Remote ai quality analyst (japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.
Role Overview:
As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.
Key Qualifications:
Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description:
In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience:
BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details:
Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
Engagement type: Contractor
Engagement Length: 3 months After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Data analyst & operations manager
description:
Data Analyst & Operations Manager
We're looking for a motivated data driven person who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success. This position is available remote in Brazil.
You solve problems by connecting your holistic business knowledge, marketing understanding and deep dive analytical abilities
You are our truffle hunter, who quickly finds smart and pragmatic ways through complex datasets and recognises patterns in business KPIs and marketing channels
You autonomously realize projects in cooperation with other colleagues as well as with marketing channels which serve the management as a strategic decision-making basis for growth and excellence
You filter growth relevant information from our BI/tracking systems and convert complexity into simplicity
You find strategies to automate marketing campaigns, improve targeting and drive marketing efficiency

Degree in Engineering, TI, Business Informatics, Economics, Statistics, Data Science or similar
Strong analytical skills: able to break down problems, test hypotheses, track the impact of solutions on the respective problems.
Great experience with tools such as Excel and Power BI or similar
Know-how in Google Analytics is nice to have
Know-how in Facebook Ads is nice to have
Know-how in segmentation is nice to have
Fluent in English and Portuguese; every other European language is a plus
You have an impact. With innovation and smart technology, we create comfy sustainable shoes and digital assets for the future generations. We want your ideas and give you autonomy to make them reality.
At Undo For Tomorrow we are flexible. Organize your own schedule, and balance work between the office and home as it's best for you. We give you trust-based hours and a flexible smart working policy.
Teamwork makes the dream work. Our team has people from 3 different continents. We work in a multicultural environment where we can challenge and support each other.
We're building for the long term, and that means protecting our planet. We constantly test new green technologies and new opportunities, both physical and digital. We are a Brazilian / European footwear startup with headquarters in Lisbon preparing to sell globally. We started not so long ago (2021) and we are growing fast with many challenges and new market opportunities to unlock.
We believe that innovation and technology allied to sustainability is key to success in one of the most competitive markets on the planet. Our goal is to bring comfort and well being to our growing community.
Our journey has just begun. Are you ready to join us and help shape the future?

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.
Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries

title: Senior full-stack mobile engineer (react native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native i OS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.
Fly Me Out is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.
We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.
What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, Type Script, Tan Stack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/Type Script backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.
Day to day, you'll be working on things like:
Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with Type Script
Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team You should have:
5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
Strong experience with Expo, Type Script, and modern state management (Tan Stack Query, Zustand, or similar)
Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome Nice to have:
Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
Apple Pay integration experience Why Fly Me Out:
Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction Compensation & Terms
This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.
Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)
Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)
Health benefits: Not offered at this stage
Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis
Probation: 2 weeks
Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil
How to Apply
Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.

At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

title: Support specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands' customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we're just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.
Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!
About the opportunity
As a Support Specialist at Drip, you'll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.
This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.
We're engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that? Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed. Customer Support
Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system. Documentation & Reporting
Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes. Escalation Management
Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution. Skills & Qualifications:
Technical Expertise:
Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, mac OS, Linux) and common software applications.
Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
Problem-solving Ability:
An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
Organizational Skills:
Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Experience:
Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, i OS).
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications:
Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern Saa S platforms. Who You Are:
A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
You're an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn't run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
Passion for helping others internally and externally
Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
In addition, we give bonus points for having a Saa S or Ecommerce background!

title: Software engineering manager
description:
Who we are
We're a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we'll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let's see what we can accomplish together!
Your role
As an Engineering Manager, you'll be leading a full stack or backend team focused on one of the key opportunities for Playlist.
You will:
Empower your engineering team to deliver a high level of technical quality and business impact.
Recruit a diverse team of engineers that are amongst the best in the industry, from outreach to closing.
Manage a team of engineers and help develop their careers with stretch responsibilities and excellent feedback.
Be actively involved in strategic direction and product decisions for your team.
Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Playlist's engineering management team. About the right team member
You are an experienced engineer turned successful people leader who is passionate about creating impactful and high-quality web applications. You have deep experience in at least one aspect of developing a world class web application and you can manage a high performing team through the entire process.
You'll thrive in this role with experience in:
3+ years of directly managing a full stack or backend engineering team of at least 6 people.
Experience shipping high quality websites or mobile applications.
You have established the architecture and best practices for web or mobile applications and their backends.
You have a proven ability to establish and articulate a vision, set goals, develop and execute.

title: Business development manager – industrial market
description:
Hikvision is the world's largest supplier of video surveillance products and solutions. The company specializes in video surveillance technology, as well as designing and manufacturing a full line of innovative CCTV and video surveillance products. Since its establishment in 2001, Hikvision has quickly achieved a leading worldwide market position in the security industry.
Hikvision possesses the world's largest R& D team and state-of-art manufacturing facilities; both allow Hikvision's customers the benefit of world-class products that are designed with cutting-edge technology. The infrared thermography product line ranges from sensors, modules to full-featured products.
Business Development Manager – Industrial Market
Country: Brazil
The Business Development Manager – Industrial Market should have large experience for developing Industrial market by approaching and building solid relationship with both Distributors and End Users.
The key attributes and expectations of a good Business Development Manager are:
•Great business sense and market sense
•Massive customer resource regarding industrial market
•Great communication skills
•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred
•A positive attitude
•Great negotiation skills
•Initiative, Honesty and Integrity
Hikvision therefore requires the Business Development manager to act as the ambassador of the company and brand, delivering the following key tasks:
•Develop/Manager Industrial market, and carry out market research, competitor and customer surveys
•Find potential business opportunities and business growth points
•Approaching and establishing new, solid and long-term relationships with distributors and end users
•Presentation of the solution to potential customers
•Support marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events.
•Work closely with colleagues in the regional sales team
•Perform lobbying in associations and interest groups.
•Assist consultants to specify projects
•Position HIKMICRO as the preferred product for consultants.
•Prepare reports required by the management.
Your Profile:
•Experience in the industrial market.
•Proven negotiation skills on cooperate level.
•Being open minded to working in a multi-cultural company.
•Being self-driven and ambitious to be part of a winning culture.
•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred
•Strong communication skills in English,both oral and written
•Solid in Outlook and related products.

title: Business development manager/director
description:
Ping Pong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300 B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world's leading cross-border platforms – and we're just getting started.
Ping Pong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.
Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.
WHAT' S THE CHALLENGE?
You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You'll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You've got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.
WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH
You'll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You'll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next. WHAT YOU BRING
Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams. WHO YOU ARE
Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
Customer-focused, you can't imagine working in any other way, and it's the only way to achieve our goals.
Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders Ping Pong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.
We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

title: Meitu campus ambassador (analytics track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship
We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.
What you'll do:
● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.
● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.
● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.
● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.
We're looking for someone who is:
● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the "why" behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.
● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.
● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.
Bonus if you have:
● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.
● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).
● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.
What You'll Get
Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team
● Early access to product features and training sessions
● Workshops on social media, product, or design
Rewards & Credit System
We'll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!
Redeem credits for:
● Annual Meitu products membership
● " Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador" Certificate + internship reference
● Meitu Special Deisgn
● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership
● Summer Internship Offer
● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)
About Meitu
Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.
Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357. HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Desenvolvedor servicenow | especialista técnico de aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):
O desenvolvedor Service Now fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do Service Now. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.
Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:
Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.
Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.
Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.
Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.
Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.
Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).
Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.
Integrar o APM com outros módulos do Service Now, incluindo ITSM e SAM.
Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.
Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.
Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.
Qualificações e Requisitos
Qualificações essenciais
• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada
• Certificação Service Now System Administrator (CSA)
• Certificação Service Now Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer
• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos
Competências-chave
8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI
Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e Java Script
Experiência na plataforma Service Now como Administrador e Desenvolvedor
Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB
Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração Service Now nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs
Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável
Outras habilidades e competências
Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado
Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão
Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Customer success associate
description:
About Ad Manage.ai Type: Full-Time We're building the Cursor for ad management.
Ad Manage.ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & Tik Tok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50 M+ in ad spend, our mission is to level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.
Our platform launches 900,000+ ads per month, saving advertisers hours with bulk ad creation, creative mining, and AI-powered campaign tools. We're profitable, fast-moving, and backed by experience — not just ideas.
The Mission Our users are ambitious brands and agencies who rely on us not just for software, but for expertise that helps them scale profitably. That's where you come in.
We're looking for a Junior Customer Success Manager with a media buying background who can bridge the gap between software and performance marketing. You'll ensure our customers get real outcomes with Ad Manage.ai — not just features. You'll be supported by a strong CS team and learn fast.
What You'll Do
Support onboarding: help guide new customers from setup to first wins alongside senior team members.
Be a go-to resource: use your media buying knowledge to answer questions on campaign structure, creative testing, and platform features.
Drive adoption: help customers unlock the full value of features like bulk ad launching, creative mining, and performance dashboards.
Build relationships: be a reliable, friendly point of contact for brands, agencies, and growth teams.
Close the feedback loop: surface customer pain points to our product and engineering teams. We ship continuously — your insights will hit production fast.
Help reduce churn: flag at-risk accounts early and work with the team to find solutions. What We're Looking For
At least 6 months of experience in a customer-facing role (CSM, account management, support, or similar in a Saa S company).
Strong communication skills — you're confident on Google Meet, email, and Slack.
Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, including Claude Code for automating repetitive tasks, drafting customer communications, or building lightweight internal tools.
Startup mentality: eager to learn, comfortable with ambiguity, and happy to wear multiple hats.
Curiosity, empathy, and a bias for action are non-negotiable. Bonus Points For
Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager or Tik Tok Ads at a campaign level
Any exposure to Saa S tools or ad tech platforms
Experience using Claude Code or similar agentic AI tools to automate workflows
Prior internship or junior role at a startup or agency
Some hands-on experience with paid social (Meta, Tik Tok) — whether through internships, agency work, freelance, or running your own campaigns. Why Join Us
Join an amazing Customer Success team and grow fast.
Direct impact: your feedback shapes our product roadmap from day one.
Work alongside founders who've scaled brands like ZOE, Photoroom, and Nextdoor. How to Apply Send your Linked In and 2–3 lines on: What's a performance marketing challenge you've helped solve — or one you're fascinated by? Bonus: any results or campaigns you're proud of, however small.

title: Especialista em inteligência artificial - engenheiro(a) de software
description:
estamos procurando um(a) especialista em Inteligência Artificial para integrar nossa equipe e desenvolver soluções avançadas de análise de dados aplicadas à engenharia civil subterrânea.
O foco da posição é o desenvolvimento de modelos próprios de IA para análise e previsão do comportamento de parâmetros geotécnicos em obras subterrâneas, contribuindo para a melhoria da análise e gestão de riscos em projetos de infraestrutura.
O que você vai fazer:
• Desenvolver e aprimorar modelos de Machine Learning aplicados a dados geotécnicos.
• Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados técnicos para análise e modelagem.
• Participar do desenvolvimento de tecnologias de reconhecimento e análise do frente de escavação utilizando sensores avançados (ex. Li DAR).
• Colaborar com engenheiros e especialistas em obras subterrâneas para transformar dados em soluções práticas para análise e gestão de riscos geotécnicos.
O que buscamos:
• Formação em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação, Inteligência Artificial ou áreas similares.
• Experiência com Python e frameworks de Machine Learning / Deep Learning.
• Experiência em análise e processamento de dados.
• Interesse em aplicar IA a desafios reais de engenharia, infraestrutura e gestão de riscos.
Diferenciais:
• Experiência com visão computacional.
• Experiência com processamento de nuvens de pontos (Li DAR).
• Experiência com modelagem de dados técnicos ou científicos.

title: Pessoa gerente financeira
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de PR e Marketing Tech da América Latina. Nós transformamos dados em decisões estratégicas. Com o uso de inteligência artificial e monitoramento de mídia de ponta, ajudamos marcas globais a entenderem sua reputação e o mercado em tempo real.
Somos movidos por inovação, mas o que realmente nos sustenta são as pessoas. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, onde a tecnologia e a estratégia caminham juntas, seu lugar é aqui.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Gestão de Pessoas e Estrutura da Área:
Liderar, desenvolver e estruturar o time financeiro, garantindo clareza de papéis, evolução técnica e um ambiente orientado a resultados e eficiência operacional.
Faturamento (Billing):
Assegurar a acuracidade e escalabilidade do faturamento, garantindo aderência ao modelo de negócio (Saa S/recorrente), com foco em eficiência operacional e mitigação de riscos.
Contas a Receber (AR) e Gestão de Inadimplência:
Definir estratégias e acompanhar indicadores de recebimento, atuando na redução de inadimplência, melhoria do ciclo de caixa e eficiência na conversão de receita em caixa.

Gerir o fluxo de caixa de curto, médio e longo prazo, garantindo liquidez, otimização do capital de giro e alocação eficiente dos recursos financeiros.
Compras e Gestão de Custos:
Gerir processos de compras e contratos, buscando eficiência, redução de custos e melhoria contínua na relação com fornecedores.

Estruturar e garantir a aderência a políticas, processos e controles financeiros, assegurando conformidade, governança e mitigação de riscos.

Consolidar e apresentar análises financeiras (DRE, fluxo de caixa, unit economics, indicadores de performance), apoiando a diretoria na tomada de decisão estratégica.
Estruturação de Processos e Eficiência:
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e ganho de escala nos processos financeiros, elevando o nível de maturidade da área.

Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidada em gestão de áreas financeiras;
Experiência na liderança de equipes e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
Conhecimento sólido em Tesouraria, Contas a Pagar/Receber, Faturamento e Planejamento Financeiro;
Domínio de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de análise (Excel/Google Sheets). Também é legal se você tiver:
Pós-graduação ou especialização em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência em empresas Saa S ou modelos de receita recorrente;
Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos;
Experiência com estruturação de processos, automações e melhoria contínua;
Conhecimento em indicadores financeiros de Saa S (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR, etc.);
Experiência em interação com investidores, auditorias ou governança corporativa.

description:
Estamos contratando: Tech Lead (foco Frontend)
Se você é o tipo de profissional que não só escreve código — mas eleva o time inteiro a um novo nível — essa vaga é pra você.
Sobre a vaga
Somos uma empresa Saa S em crescimento, com produtos digitais rodando em produção. Temos um time de frontend que precisa de direção técnica real: alguém que faça code review com profundidade, defina padrões, garanta qualidade e ainda contribua com código quando necessário.

→ Liderar tecnicamente o time (2 devs frontend plenos + 1 backend pleno + 1 sênior backend)
→ Conduzir code reviews de React e Next.js com critério e profundidade
→ Definir padrões de arquitetura, componentização e qualidade frontend
→ Estruturar o processo de desenvolvimento do zero
→ Identificar gargalos e remover bloqueios do time
→ Dar feedback claro e direto quando necessário
O que esperamos
→ Experiência sólida com React e Next.js (obrigatório)
→ Capacidade de liderar e fazer code review com autoridade técnica no frontend
→ Perfil hands-on: lidera e ainda contribui com código
→ Experiência com Type Script, boas práticas de performance e acessibilidade
→ Familiaridade com PHP é um diferencial, não um requisito
→ Experiência em estruturar processos em times sem metodologia definida

Remuneração: A combinar
100% Remoto

As inscrições são feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso processo seletivo online, onde você responde perguntas técnicas e comportamentais e já recebe na hora um parecer sobre sua compatibilidade com a vaga.

title: Full-time social ads specialist
description:
About Us
Blue Tuskr is a U. S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we're looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.
What You'll Do
As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.
Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to Linked In, Pinterest, and Tik Tok.
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.
This role requires a strong understanding of post-i OS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.
More specifically, in this role you will:
Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates What We're Looking For
4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships What This Role Is NOT
This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.
Time Commitment
Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.
Pay
$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.
If you're passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units. SELECTION CRITERIA
Essential:
Bachelor / master's degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
Experience in S/4 HANA environment and Fiori applications.
Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline Desirable:
SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4 HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks. WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS
Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
Health and Safety accountability statements.
Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis. We are the ASSA ABLOY Group
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. title: Subject matter expert – chartered & certified accountants (remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing
Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)
Eligible Locations:
Language Requirement: Fluent English
Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory
Hourly Rate: $60.00
Minimum Hours: No minimum
Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability
About Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Data analyst v
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL
Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência
Modelo de trabalho: Home office
Visão Geral da Posição
A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.
O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.
O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.
O que você fará
Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics. Qualificações Mínimas
Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
Inglês fluente. Qualificações Desejáveis
Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark).
Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora com experiência em Kotlin para integrar nosso time. Procuramos alguém com paixão por tecnologia, vontade de aprender e colaborar para construir soluções inovadoras que gerem impacto no negócio e na experiência de nossos clientes.
Responsabilidade e atribuições:
Tenha paixão por tecnologia e se mantenha atualizado(a) sobre as novidades do setor;
Goste de aprender e trabalhar com diferentes tecnologias e linguagens;
Participe ativamente das rotinas do time, propondo e discutindo soluções que atendam aos objetivos do negócio;
Tenha um olhar crítico e senso de dono sobre o que criamos no dia a dia;
Acompanhe e utilize métricas e indicadores do time para identificar e propor melhorias, sustentabilidade e novas oportunidades;
Colabore na criação e evolução dos fluxos de trabalho do time, garantindo eficácia e eficiência;
Desenvolva, coloque em produção, monitore e mantenha a saúde dos softwares e serviços entregues;
Melhore continuamente as bases de código, equilibrando velocidade de entrega e qualidade;
Realize e aceite feedbacks como parte de um ambiente colaborativo e voltado ao crescimento;
Assuma o protagonismo do seu autodesenvolvimento e da evolução da sua carreira profissional. Requisitos e qualificações:
Programação orientada a objetos;
Experiência com Java (21 ou 24)
Experiência com Kotlin;
Frameworks como Spring Boot, Spring Data, e uso de JPA;
Design de APIs REST;
Arquitetura de microsserviços;
Conhecimento em princípios como SOLID, Clean Code e padrões de projeto;
Experiência com CI/CD e ferramentas de automação;
Testes unitários e de integração;
Conhecimento em Docker e conteinerização;
Familiaridade com mensageria (ex.: Kafka, Rabbit MQ, SQS, SNS);
Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
Experiência com controle de versão usando Git;
Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em sistemas distribuídos (OAuth, JWT, etc.);
Experiência em processos de Code Review para garantir qualidade e boas práticas. O que oferecemos:
Saúde e Bem-estar
Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
Seguro de Vida;
Programa Lado a Lado, com apoio jurídico, social, psicológico e financeiro;
Wellhub. Alimentação/ Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho:
Cartão de crédito Pic Pay Benefícios, com ampla aceitação, onde você recebe seu saldo de Alimentação/Refeição e Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho (de acordo com o seu contrato de trabalho). Licença Paternidade e Maternidade:
Licença Maternidade estendida de 6 meses, e de Paternidade também estendida de 20 dias.
Programa \"Novo Ser\", que acompanha nossas mamães durante toda a gestação e no retorno da licença. Falando nisso, ao retornar da licença maternidade, as mamães ainda contam com a ajuda do Auxílio Creche e também os papais que possuem guarda unilateral ou compartilhada. Reconhecemos resultados: PPR- Participação nos Resultados do Pic Pay.
